arguments.content:
"""Line indentation."""

from __future__ import annotations


def indent(text: str, prefix: str, *, skip_blank: bool = False) -> str:
    """Add ``prefix`` to the start of every line of ``text``.

    Line endings (``\\n``, ``\\r\\n``) are preserved exactly, and no newline is
    added or removed.

    Args:
        text: Input text.
        prefix: String to put in front of each line.
        skip_blank: If ``True``, lines that are empty or contain only
            whitespace are returned unchanged (no prefix, and their own
            whitespace preserved). Defaults to ``False``.

    Returns:
        The indented text.
    """
    if skip_blank:
        return "".join(
            prefix + line if line.strip() else line
            for line in text.splitlines(keepends=True)
        )
    return "".join(prefix + line for line in text.splitlines(keepends=True))
